rewrite.hint: Notice which operator joins the two Record types, then work out what a single value must provide to be accepted by it.
rewrite.explanation: Each Record contributes one required property and & requires a value to satisfy both, so T behaves as { a: number; b: string }; the compiler still prints the intersection, but the two types are assignable to each other in both directions. A union would let a value satisfy only one side, which is the opposite of &. The intersection is not never either: object types with different keys have nothing to conflict over.

rationale: The union option is the classic and/or confusion, so the item earns its place at Mixed Mastery. Only the hint and explanation fall short; mutual assignability was verified rather than assumed.
